research.audience: Teenage girls and young working women (16-25) in India who add cute accessories to bags and phones
research.problem: Standard black keys look boring and don't match their aesthetic, pastel-colored bag or phone case
research.buyer_moment: Checking outfit in the mirror before college, realizing the bag looks plain and clipping the pastel cloud keychain to the strap for a 'kawaii' touch
research.surprise_detail: The cloud pendant features a small blue circular accent that resembles an earphone button or a dot on a face
features: Pastel cartoon cloud shape with smiling face
research.best_angle: Relatable pain to aesthetic upgrade: showing the dull bag vs the bag with the cute cloud charm
research.people_reason: To show the size relative to the bag strap and demonstrate the action of clipping the keychain

script.facts: Pastel cartoon cloud shape with smiling face; Hanging star-shaped pendant
